steps.command:
cd /app
echo "== indexes =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
echo "== counts =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"
echo "== synset dup check =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets;"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT senseid) FROM senses;"
echo "== plan =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat my-sql-query.sql)" 2>&1 | head -50

cd /app
sqlite3 --version
echo "== orphan senses (synsetid not in synsets) =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets y ON s.synsetid=y.synsetid WHERE y.synsetid IS NULL;"
echo "== duplicate wordids in words =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid FROM words GROUP BY wordid HAVING COUNT(*)>1);"
echo "== words with senses but no synsets row? =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.wordid) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets y ON s.synsetid=y.synsetid WHERE y.synsetid IS NULL;"
echo "== timing original (limit wall) =="
time timeout 300 sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat my-sql-query.sql)" | wc -l

sbx put /workspace/cand.sql <<'EOF'
WITH word_stats AS (
  SELECT w.wordid AS wordid,
         w.word AS word,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM pairs
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id,
       ws.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets,
       ws.total_senses,
       ws.distinct_domains,
       ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
echo "== timing candidate =="
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/cand.sql > /workspace/cand.out
wc -l /workspace/cand.out
head -5 /workspace/cand.out
echo "== plan =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/cand.sql)"
EOF

cd /app
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /workspace/orig.out
echo "orig lines: $(wc -l < /workspace/orig.out)"
if diff -q /workspace/orig.out /workspace/cand.out; then echo "IDENTICAL"; else echo "DIFFERENCES:"; diff /workspace/orig.out /workspace/cand.out | head -40; fi

cd /app
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.wordid FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY s.wordid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2 AND COUNT(*)>=2);"

# Variant B: no window, max/min approach
cat > /workspace/vb.sql <<'SQL'
WITH word_stats AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s JOIN word_stats ws ON ws.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
mx AS (SELECT wordid, MAX(cnt) AS mc FROM pairs GROUP BY wordid),
top AS (
  SELECT p.wordid AS wordid, MIN(p.synsetid) AS synsetid, MAX(p.cnt) AS cnt
  FROM pairs p JOIN mx m ON m.wordid = p.wordid AND m.mc = p.cnt
  GROUP BY p.wordid
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets, ws.total_senses, ws.distinct_domains, ws.distinct_posids,
       t.synsetid AS top_synsetid, t.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN top t ON t.wordid = ws.wordid
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL

echo "== B =="; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/vb.sql > /workspace/vb.out
diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/vb.out && echo "B IDENTICAL"

cd /app

# vc: pairs over ALL senses (no join to word_stats) + max/min
sed 's/FROM senses s JOIN word_stats ws ON ws.wordid = s.wordid/FROM senses s/' /workspace/vb.sql > /workspace/vc.sql
echo "== C (pairs all senses) =="; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/vc.sql > /workspace/vc.out
diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/vc.out && echo "C IDENTICAL"

# vd: window over restricted pairs
cat > /workspace/vd.sql <<'SQL'
WITH word_stats AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM senses s JOIN word_stats ws ON ws.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets, ws.total_senses, ws.distinct_domains, ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo "== D (window restricted) =="; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/vd.sql > /workspace/vd.out
diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/vd.out && echo "D IDENTICAL"

echo "== plan B =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/vb.sql)"

cd /app
cat > /workspace/ve.sql <<'SQL'
WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid,
         syn.domainid AS domainid, syn.posid AS posid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
stats AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids,
         MAX(cnt) AS mc
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
top AS (
  SELECT p.wordid AS wordid, MIN(p.synsetid) AS synsetid, MAX(p.cnt) AS cnt
  FROM pairs p JOIN stats st ON st.wordid = p.wordid AND st.mc = p.cnt
  GROUP BY p.wordid
)
SELECT st.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       st.total_synsets, st.total_senses, st.distinct_domains, st.distinct_posids,
       t.synsetid AS top_synsetid, t.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM stats st
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = st.wordid
JOIN top t ON t.wordid = st.wordid
ORDER BY st.total_senses DESC, st.total_synsets DESC, st.distinct_domains DESC, st.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo "distinct pairs: $(sqlite3 oewn.sqlite 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT wordid,synsetid FROM senses);')"
for f in vb vd ve; do
  echo "== $f =="
  for i in 1 2 3; do /usr/bin/time -f "%e s" sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/$f.sql > /workspace/$f.out; done
  diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/$f.out && echo "$f IDENTICAL"
done
echo "== plan E =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/ve.sql)"

cd /app
for f in vb vd ve; do
  echo "== $f =="
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    s=$(date +%s%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/$f.sql > /workspace/$f.out; e=$(date +%s%N)
    echo "$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"
  done
  diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/$f.out && echo "$f IDENTICAL"
done
# also re-time candidate and original-derived baseline cand
echo "== cand =="
for i in 1 2 3; do s=$(date +%s%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/cand.sql > /workspace/cand.out2; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"; done
diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/cand.out2 && echo "cand IDENTICAL"

cd /app
t(){ s=$(date +%s%N); eval "$1" > /dev/null; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "$2: $(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"; }
t "sqlite3 oewn.sqlite 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,COUNT(*) FROM senses GROUP BY wordid)'" "group senses by word"
t "sqlite3 oewn.sqlite 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid,COUNT(*) FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid)'" "group senses by word,synset"
t "sqlite3 oewn.sqlite 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.wordid,COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid),COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid),COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY s.wordid)'" "full word_stats"
t "sqlite3 oewn.sqlite 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.wordid,s.synsetid,COUNT(*) FROM senses s JOIN (SELECT s.wordid,COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) ts,COUNT(*) tn,COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) dd FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY s.wordid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2 AND COUNT(*)>=2) ws ON ws.wordid=s.wordid GROUP BY s.wordid,s.synsetid)'" "restricted pairs"

cat > /workspace/vg.sql <<'SQL'
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
stats AS (
  SELECT b.wordid AS wordid, b.total_synsets AS total_synsets, b.total_senses AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM base b
  JOIN senses s ON s.wordid = b.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY b.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM senses s JOIN stats st ON st.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT st.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       st.total_synsets, st.total_senses, st.distinct_domains, st.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM stats st
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = st.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = st.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY st.total_senses DESC, st.total_synsets DESC, st.distinct_domains DESC, st.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo "== vg =="
for i in 1 2 3; do s=$(date +%s%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /workspace/vg.sql > /workspace/vg.out; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"; done
diff -q /workspace/cand.out /workspace/vg.out && echo "vg IDENTICAL"

cd /app
echo "== plan D =="
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /workspace/vd.sql)"
echo "== output hash check =="
sha256sum /workspace/cand.out /workspace/vd.out

sbx put /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH word_stats AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         s.synsetid AS synsetid,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM senses s
  JOIN word_stats ws ON ws.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets,
       ws.total_senses,
       ws.distinct_domains,
       ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC,
         ws.total_synsets DESC,
         ws.distinct_domains DESC,
         ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
echo "== file contents =="
cat sol.sql
echo "== run final =="
for i in 1 2 3; do s=$(date +%s%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /workspace/sol.out; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"; done
echo "== rows =="; wc -l < /workspace/sol.out
echo "== exact match vs original =="
diff -q /workspace/orig.out /workspace/sol.out && echo "IDENTICAL"
sha256sum /workspace/orig.out /workspace/sol.out
EOF
